title: Auto Parry OP BLADE N BALL SCRIPT
features:
🛡️ Auto-Parry System

    Smart Auto-Parry: Automatically parries balls coming toward you with adjustable accuracy

    Multiple Parry Types: Camera, Random, Backwards, Straight, High, Left, Right directions

    Anti-Curve Detection: Compensates for curved ball trajectories

    Visualizer: Shows parry range with color-coded sphere

    Infinity/Phantom Detection: Handles special ball types

    Cooldown Protection: Manages ability cooldowns

⚡ Auto Spam & Triggerbot

    Auto Spam: Spams parry in close combat situations

    Triggerbot: Instant parry when targeted

    Practice Mode: Auto-parry for training lobbies

    Clash Mode: Manual spam toggle for intense moments

🎮 Player Enhancements

    Speed Hack: Adjustable movement speed (36-200)

    Spinbot: Rotates character continuously

    Fly: Full 3D flight with WASD+QE controls

    Field of View: Customizable camera FOV (50-150)

    AI Play: Automated movement and positioning

👁️ ESP & Visual Features

    Player ESP: Shows names, health, and distances

    Ability ESP: Displays opponents' equipped abilities

    Ball Statistics: Real-time speed and distance info

    Ball Trail: Rainbow trail effect on balls

    View Ball: Camera follows the ball

🎵 Audio & Cosmetics

    Hit Sounds: Multiple sound options on successful parries

    Skin Changer: Custom sword appearances

    Emotes: Access to all in-game emotes

    VIP Tag: Custom chat tag

⚙️ Performance & Utility

    Boost Mode: Optimizes graphics for better performance

    Anti-Lag: Reduces visual effects

    Night Mode: Darker lighting for better visibility

    Anti-AFK: Prevents being kicked for inactivity

🛒 Automation

    Auto Buy: Automatically purchases swords and explosions

    Private Servers: Quick access to private game sessions

🔧 Smart Features

    Auto-Detection: Automatically finds and updates parry mechanics

    Remote Caching: Optimizes network calls for better performance

    Connection Management: Properly handles all game connections

🎯 Key Benefits

    Adaptive: Automatically adjusts to game updates

    Customizable: Every feature can be tuned to preference

    User-Friendly: Clean UI with organized sections

    Comprehensive: Covers all aspects of Blade Ball gameplay

This script is designed to give players a significant advantage while maintaining smooth gameplay and providing extensive customization options for both competitive and casual play.
